section.title: Base pay
section.para: A courier is paid a base rate of nine units for every hour of the shift.
A shift shorter than two hours is paid as two hours.

section.title: Distance pay
section.para: Distance pay is the kilometres ridden times the distance rate for the zone.
The distance rate is zero point four units a kilometre in the outer zone.
Distance pay for one shift is capped at forty units.

section.title: Night premium
section.para: A shift beginning after ten at night earns a premium of one quarter of the base pay.
